title: Zephyr: DIO receive handler
notes: Implemented strict atomic Zephyr DIO receive handling: configured instance/DODAG enforcement, authenticated fail-closed policy, root-authorized version advancement, lollipop DTSN replay protection, mandatory current SCHC option, strict config validation, staged callback/route mutation, and RFC 6206 Trickle consistency/reset integration. Added host harness coverage for unauthenticated/missing-option rejection, atomic rollback, duplicate consistency, stale DTSN, unauthorized/authorized newer versions, and Trickle behavior. Validation: ASan/UBSan host rpl_dodag 21/21 and CTest 1/1; Zephyr 4.1 nRF52840 scoped dodag.c.obj + trickle.c.obj compile passed with SDK 0.16.8. Pinned 3.7 tree remains unavailable locally per AGENTS; no unrelated full-image expansion.
